Our team is deep this year. I made some comments on our projected starting lineup, and each time, I left out someone key. We literally have 12-13 guys that could play anywhere in the NBA, I don't think any other team besides the Golden State Warriors and the San Antonio Spurs have this kind of depth.

Point Guard

Starter: Derrick Rose, obviously.

Bench: Aaron Brooks, E'Twaun Moore, Ramon Galloway, Kirk Hinrich.

Aaron Brooks is our backup for now. Ramon Galloway looks pretty nice in Summer League, maybe we could pick him up and have him duke it out with Moore and Brooks for second string. No Kirk please (no disrespect, one of my favorite players pre-Derrick Rose). He's just not effective anymore. I take Galloway over him because at least you get to develop youth.

Shooting Guard

Starter: Jimmy Butler, obviously.

Bench: Tony Snell, Aaron Brooks, E'twaun Moore, Kirk Hinrich.

I see Snell backing up Butler mostly. Either Brooks or Moore can slide over to third string SG, leaving Galloway as 2nd or 3rd string PG. Brooks playing off-ball might be better for us, because he kind of kills ball movement but is definitely a scorer.

Small Forward

Starter: Mike Dunleavy Jr.

Bench: Doug McDermott, Tony Snell, Nikola Mirotic.

Personally, I think MDJ's starting spot could take some heat this year. Going in, he's by far our starter. However, he is getting old and we could do with developing some talent. Snell could play significant minutes here, as well as Doug. Playing Snell at SG and Doug at SF could be an option for us throughout the year. Eventually, one of those two will start for us hopefully. Nikola can also get some minutes at SF. A lineup of Rose/Butler/Mirotic/Portis/Gibson or Noah is one hell of a small ball lineup that doesn't sacrifice height.

Power Forward

Starter: Taj Gibson

Bench: Nikola Mirotic, Bobby Portis, Cameron Bairstow.

Because of our fluidity at PF/C, I will combine the writeups together.

Center

Starter: Pau Gasol

Bench: Joakim Noah.

Okay, those starter names are just placeholders, because there's a logjam here. Let's go through some potential sets. I think it's best not to start both Taj and Noah together, because that would kill our offensive ability and spacing, which is what Hoiberg values. Likewise, starting Mirotic and Pau together is a defensive liability. Pau and Mirotic stretch the floor, so we should combine a stretch and a defensive guy together. So the two potential starting sets are Taj/Pau and Mirotic/Noah. I want to give Taj the starting spot because I think he deserves it - he's spent too long as a backup. Whatever happens, the second squad will still play significant minutes (think 24).

That leaves a logjam in the second string. Portis is a rookie, but could be competing with Mirotic soon. Cameron Bairstow could be our third string C. Either way, both players look like second-string players that are pushed down to third string due to depth/youth.

Potential ideas include trading one of our veterans such as Taj, Noah, or Pau, and inserting Portis into a second-string. Because Portis is exclusively a PF (maybe he could learn C), the top trade is probably Taj, which is sad. But we could probably pick up some good pieces for him in exchange. If Portis develops into a C, perhaps we could unload Pau, although it would be difficult as his age. I think Noah is our least tradeable - I think it's worth the risk giving him a second chance after what he does for our team.

Alright, if you guys have any suggestions or if I forgot something, let me know! I'm excited for this season!
